## Install

**Linux / macOS**

```bash
curl -fsSL https://steerholm.ai/install.sh | bash
```

**Windows (PowerShell)**

```powershell
irm https://steerholm.ai/install.ps1 | iex
```

Already running Steerholm? Run `holm update`. Every archive and script is checksummed (SHA-256) in `checksums.txt`.
